name: Plot Nebula
briefing: Some patterns only show up in a picture. Plot the Crew Log decade by decade.

log.title: Entry 6: Six decades
log.text: The median mission grew from 96 hours in the 1960s to 3,912 hours (about 163 days) in the 2010s, the space-station era. Women were 1 of 44 first-time flyers in the 1960s and 11 of 55 in the 2010s.
